image_description: A white built-in bookcase unit installed in a room corner next to a fireplace. The unit features open shelving on the upper half (divided into two vertical columns) and closed cabinet storage with paneled doors on the lower half. A countertop separates the shelves from the cabinets. The shelves are currently empty. To the left is a black fireplace insert with white trim. A ceiling light fixture is visible above.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the perspective lines of the shelves. In AI images, parallel shelves often converge incorrectly or warp. Also, verify if the 'empty' state is natural or if there are strange smudges that look like failed attempts at rendering books.
